data.long_meaning: Andrija is a Slavic name derived from the root word ‘andrej’, which translates to ‘man’ or ‘warrior’. The name has been popular among Eastern European Christians for centuries and has historical significance as the name of several saints and rulers. The name Andrija carries the meaning “Man, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andrija usually hope their child will grow to embody man, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
